language.sample_text: ระวัง — งานก่อสร้างถนน
language.script_notes: Standard Thai script — Central Thai is the national standard, spoken and written throughout.

road_furniture.curb_style: Dense formal infrastructure in Bangkok including extensive elevated expressways and Skytrain lines.
road_furniture.km_marker_style: Dense overhead cable clutter on Bangkok's streets is a strong urban tell.

architecture.roof_style: Multi-tiered ornate Buddhist temple roofs with glazed orange and green tiles dominate; flat-roofed concrete shophouses and high-rises fill Bangkok.
architecture.roof_material: Glazed orange/green ceramic tile on temples; flat concrete on urban buildings.
architecture.wall_construction: Dense concrete shophouse and high-rise construction in Bangkok; traditional Thai stilt houses (often teak) survive in canal-side and rural central-plains villages; ornate, gilded royal and temple architecture (Grand Palace, Wat Arun).
architecture.wall_color_palette: Bright, varied shopfront colours overlaid with dense signage in urban areas; gold, white, and glazed orange/green on temples.
architecture.distinctive_building_types: Bangkok's skyline mixing modern skyscrapers and ornate gilded temples (Wat Arun, Grand Palace); canal-side stilt houses; elevated BTS Skytrain and expressway structures; ubiquitous roadside spirit houses; Ayutthaya's ancient ruined brick temples.

nature.vegetation: Flat, intensively irrigated rice paddies dominate the countryside, with scattered coconut and sugar palms and fruit orchards along canals.
nature.terrain: The fertile, flat Chao Phraya river delta and central plain — Thailand's agricultural heartland — with an extensive network of canals (khlongs).
nature.climate_signature: Hot, humid, and flat — a much less mountainous look than the north; frequent monsoon flooding across low-lying plains.

vehicles.plate_color: Bangkok plates carry 'กรุงเทพมหานคร' (Bangkok Metropolis) beneath the number.
vehicles.distinctive_vehicles: Tuk-tuks and pink/green/blue metered taxis (Bangkok's taxi colours) are iconic; extremely heavy motorbike and traffic density in Bangkok.

google_coverage.camera_generation: Mostly Gen 3/4, the densest coverage in Thailand.
google_coverage.coverage_notes: Very dense, near-complete coverage in Bangkok and the surrounding plains.

confusion_set.shared_traits: Similar flat, canal-laced rice-paddy delta terrain and tropical humid climate
confusion_set.tiebreaker: Thailand drives on the LEFT while Vietnam drives on the right; Thai script differs sharply from Vietnamese Latin-with-diacritics.

confusion_set.shared_traits: Same country, same plate/bollard base style
confusion_set.tiebreaker: Central Thailand is flat rice-paddy plains and dense Bangkok urbanity; the north is mountainous with carved Lanna temples, and the south is a rubber/palm-covered peninsula.
